question: Which among the following enzymes helps in breaking down fats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lipase**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lipase**

 
 
• Lipases are enzymes that help in breaking down** fats** in the body.
 
• They are primarily produced by the** pancreas** and are **secreted into the small intestine**.
 
• The main function of lipases is to** hydrolyze**, or **split**, fats into their individual components: **glycerol and fatty acids**.
 
• When you consume food, the fats remain undigested until they reach the **small intestine**.
 
• In the small intestine, lipases break down the complex fat molecules into **simpler forms**.
